title: iMuslim: Prayer Times & Quran
description:
iMuslim gives you accurate, GPS-based Muslim prayer times anywhere in the world — with Athan alarm, Qibla compass, the Holy Quran with audio, Hijri calendar, Ramadan times and a nearby mosque finder, all in one beautifully simple app trusted by over 1 million Muslims.

🕌 ACCURATE PRAYER TIMES (SALAT / NAMAZ)
• Precise salat times for Fajr, Dhuhr (Zuhr), Asr, Maghrib and Isha based on your exact location
• Namaz times update automatically when you travel — perfect for trips and daily commutes
• Times for Ishraq, Awwabin and Tahajjud prayers
• Forbidden (makruh) prayer times clearly shown
• Multiple calculation methods, Hanafi and Shafi'i Asr settings
• Monthly prayer times timetable

🔔 AZAN ALARM & PRAYER REMINDERS
• Beautiful Azan (Adhan / Athan) sounds for every prayer time
• Flexible alerts: full azan alarm, short tone, or silent notification
• Pre-prayer reminders so you never miss salah in congregation
• Prayer times widget for your home screen

🧭 QIBLA COMPASS & QIBLA DIRECTION
• Fast, accurate Qibla compass pointing to the Kaaba in Makkah
• Find the Qibla direction anywhere in the world — at home or traveling

📖 AL QURAN WITH AUDIO
• Read the complete Holy Quran with a clean, comfortable layout
• Quran audio recitation with resume playback — continue right where you left off
• Translations to deepen your understanding of the Quran

🌙 RAMADAN CALENDAR — SEHRI & IFTAR TIMES
• Accurate Sehri (Suhoor) and Iftar times for your exact location
• Full Ramadan calendar for the entire blessed month
• Fasting times you can rely on, wherever you are

🕌 NEARBY MOSQUE FINDER
• Explore nearby mosques and masjids on the map
• Ideal for travelers, new neighborhoods and finding Jummah

📿 TASBIH COUNTER, DUA & MORE
• Digital tasbih (tasbeeh) counter for daily dhikr and zikr
• Dua collection for everyday moments
• Asma-ul-Husna — the 99 Names of Allah
• Hijri calendar (Islamic calendar) with today's Hijri date alongside the Gregorian date
• Multiple themes, translations and language options

WHO IS iMUSLIM FOR?
Whether you are a lifelong practicing Muslim, a new revert learning namaz, or anyone who needs reliable Islamic prayer times, azan alerts, Qibla direction and the Quran in one app — iMuslim was built for you. It is lightweight, fast, works worldwide, and respects your time.

Download iMuslim today and keep your salat on time, every time — with accurate prayer times, athan alarm, Qibla compass, Al Quran, Ramadan calendar and Hijri date in your pocket.
